en.help.layout.apply: Apply a saved layout to the current workspace. Retained editors keep their drafts.
en.help.layout.get: Read the committed layout and discover registered workspaces.
en.help.layout.reset: Restore the current workspace's registered default layout. User presets remain available.
en.help.layout.save: Save the complete layout under a name. Replacing a user preset requires explicit overwrite permission.
en.help.layout.workspace.select: Select a registered layout workspace and remember the outgoing layout.
en.help.panel.activate: Select an open panel tab without requesting keyboard focus.
en.help.panel.close: Close a panel through its content lifecycle guard. Its placement is remembered.
en.help.panel.collapse: Collapse or expand a panel section while retaining its requested dimensions.
en.help.panel.dismiss: Dismiss the temporary view of a collapsed panel.
en.help.panel.float: Move a panel into an explicitly positioned floating section.
en.help.panel.focus: Focus a panel, reopening its retained state and expanding its section when needed.
en.help.panel.list: Read registered panel kinds, committed instances, active tabs, availability and host capabilities.
en.help.panel.move: Move a panel into a new section or join an existing tab group.
en.help.panel.native_close: Return a native panel section to its remembered dock without cancelling its content.
en.help.panel.open: Open a panel kind with an explicit instance identity and placement for a new instance.
en.help.panel.peek: Temporarily show a collapsed panel without changing its saved size or collapse state.
en.help.panel.popout: Move a panel to a native host when supported. Browser hosts use a floating section.
en.help.panel.reset_pair: Restore an adjacent dock pair's default size ratio within its shared bounds.
en.help.panel.resize: Set a panel section's outer width and height within every tab's bounds.
en.help.panel.resize_pair: Resize adjacent dock sections together while conserving their shared extent.

de.help.layout.apply: Ein gespeichertes Layout auf den aktuellen Arbeitsbereich anwenden. Geöffnete Editoren behalten ihre Entwürfe.

de.help.panel.float: Ein Panel in einen frei positionierten Bereich verschieben.

de.help.panel.resize: Die äußere Breite und Höhe eines Panel-Bereichs innerhalb der Grenzen aller Registerkarten festlegen.
de.help.panel.resize_pair: Benachbarte Andockbereiche gemeinsam skalieren und ihre gemeinsame Ausdehnung beibehalten.

vi.help.panel.popout: Di chuyển bảng sang cửa sổ riêng khi được hỗ trợ. Trình duyệt sử dụng vùng thả nổi.
vi.help.panel.reset_pair: Khôi phục tỷ lệ kích thước mặc định của hai vùng gắn liền kề trong giới hạn chung.
vi.help.panel.resize: Đặt chiều rộng và chiều cao bên ngoài của vùng bảng trong giới hạn của mọi thẻ.
vi.help.panel.resize_pair: Đổi kích thước các vùng gắn liền kề cùng nhau trong khi giữ nguyên tổng chiều dài chung.

zh.cmd.panel.native_close: 重新停靠独立窗口中的面板分区
zh.help.layout.apply: 将保存的布局应用到当前工作区。保留的编辑器会继续保留其草稿。
zh.help.layout.get: 读取已提交的布局并查看已注册的工作区。
zh.help.layout.reset: 恢复当前工作区注册的默认布局。用户预设仍会保留。
zh.help.layout.save: 为完整布局命名并保存。替换用户预设需要明确允许覆盖。
zh.help.layout.workspace.select: 选择已注册的布局工作区，并记住离开前的布局。
zh.help.panel.activate: 选择已打开的面板选项卡，而不请求键盘焦点。
zh.help.panel.close: 通过内容生命周期检查后关闭面板。其位置会被记住。
zh.help.panel.collapse: 折叠或展开面板分区，同时保留所需尺寸。
zh.help.panel.dismiss: 关闭折叠面板的临时视图。
zh.help.panel.float: 将面板移至位置明确指定的浮动分区。
zh.help.panel.focus: 聚焦面板，必要时重新打开其保留状态并展开分区。
zh.help.panel.list: 读取已注册的面板种类、已提交的实例、活动选项卡、可用状态和宿主能力。
zh.help.panel.move: 将面板移至新分区，或加入现有的选项卡组。
zh.help.panel.native_close: 将独立窗口中的面板分区返回记住的停靠位置，而不取消其内容。
zh.help.panel.open: 使用明确的实例标识打开指定种类的面板。新实例需要指定位置。
zh.help.panel.peek: 临时显示折叠的面板，而不更改保存的尺寸或折叠状态。
zh.help.panel.popout: 支持时将面板移至独立窗口。浏览器宿主会使用浮动分区。
zh.help.panel.reset_pair: 在共同约束内恢复相邻停靠分区对的默认尺寸比例。
zh.help.panel.resize: 在所有选项卡的约束内设置面板分区的外部宽度和高度。
zh.help.panel.resize_pair: 同时调整相邻停靠分区的尺寸，并保持其共同总长度。
